system.description: The character has a scholarly mentor, not necessarily her sire but someone with the patience and resources to school her in a course of study. At the end of each story, so long as the character maintained extended contact with her patron, the player rolls dice equal to her rating in the Mentor Background (difficulty 10 minus the character's Intelligence). Each success grants one experience point to spend on increasing a Knowledge, though no more than half the points spent to raise any one Knowledge may come from this Merit. Requires at least one dot of Mentor.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis II: Keepers of the Word, Book Three: Zealots
